name: Zayed International Airport

slots.v: an IATA level 2 (schedules facilitated) airport, with Airport Coordination Limited (ACL) as facilitator

runway.v: two parallel runways, 13R/31L and 13L/31R; the chart gives 4,100 m x 60 m and 4,106 m x 60 m asphalt (it does not pair the lengths with the runway names)

hours.v: open 24 hours a day, every day of the year (as stated on the slot coordinator's airport page; not a customs-hours or no-curfew statement)
hours.quote: Zayed International Airport is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, year round.
